## What this letter says
Noah was seen in the Children's Emergency Department on 26 September 2026. He had a temperature of 38.5°C. He has a viral infection (a germ called a virus). He was drinking well and playing when he left the department. He does not need antibiotics.

## What you need to do
1. See your GP (family doctor) if Noah is not better in 5 days.
2. Do not give Noah antibiotics. The letter says they are not needed.

## Dates and medicines
- 26 September 2026: Noah was seen in the Children's Emergency Department.
- Medicines: the letter lists no medicines for Noah.
- Antibiotics are not needed.

## Questions to ask your doctor
- How will I know if Noah is getting better?
- What should I do if Noah is not better in 5 days?
- Why are antibiotics not needed for Noah?

## When to get urgent help
The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.
